name: shimmer-button
title: Shimmer button
description: A primary button with a slow sheen, and an optional lean towards the pointer.

props.name: magnetic
props.description: Lean a few pixels towards the pointer.

a11y.text: A native button, so Tab, Enter and Space work as usual. It accepts all button attributes and has a minimum height of 44 px.
The shimmer is an aria-hidden span, so only the button label is read. A disabled button is dimmed.
The shimmer span is hidden under reduced motion. The magnetic lean is skipped under reduced motion and for any pointer that is not a mouse. The press scale has no transition under reduced motion.
